analysis.original_request: 我负责一款人眼安全级别的 1550 nm 相干激光雷达（LiDAR）接收前端的窄带滤波膜研发。接收机使用 1550 nm 附近的窄线宽激光，需要该波段尽可能高的透过率（目标 ≥ 0.95），同时大幅抑制 1400-1500 nm 和 1600-1700 nm 两个邻近波段的背景辐射，以减少阳光及其他杂散光的干扰。请在空气入射、熔融石英基底条件下，仅使用 Ta2O5 和 SiO2 设计一个平面多层介质膜，膜系总层数不超过 30 层。
analysis.normalized_request_english: Design a planar multilayer dielectric filter for a 1550 nm coherent LiDAR receiver front-end. Incident medium is unspecified material, substrate is Fused Silica. Materials are limited to Ta2O5 and SiO2. Total layers must not exceed 30. Target high transmittance (soft target ≥ 0.95) at 1550 nm. Strongly suppress background radiation in 1400-1500 nm and 1600-1700 nm bands.
analysis.compatibility_reason: Request specifies planar isotropic layered media compatible with transfer-matrix method.
preferred_behaviors: strong suppression of transmittance in 1400-1500 nm and 1600-1700 nm
ambiguities: angle of incidence not explicitly specified
exact passband width around 1550 nm not defined
method_research_questions: how to achieve ≥ 0.95 transmission with ≤ 30 layers while suppressing side bands

validation_warnings: unrequested material assumptions were replaced with unspecified
unrequested numeric assumptions were replaced with unspecified
